sum: Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. designs and develops artificial intelligence-powered robotics and autonomous systems for defense, homeland security, and commercial security applications. The company's core platform, XOS (XTEND Operating System), connects autonomous platforms, AI, and operators into one intelligent software foundation for coordinated missions across air, ground, and maritime domains. The company also provides AI Pilots software, which perceive, decide, and coordinate autonomous missions while keeping operators in command; common software layer that enables autonomous platforms to perceive, decide, coordinate, and execute missions across hardware and environments; and AI Native for autonomous operations from the ground up. Xtend AI Robotics, Inc. was founded in 2018 and is based in Tampa, Florida.
